utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo. I could use help sorting the donated parts and maybe making a quick list of what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I can sort the donated parts and jot down a quick fix list. What should I start with?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d want to know the timing and what exactly needs to be dropped off first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, can you confirm when it’s happening and what needs to be dropped off first?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’d like to know the exact time and the first item on the list before I commit. If you can share that, I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. What needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m a bit foggy, but I think we still need to sort the donations and see what’s already been fixed. If you want, I can help check the list again.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, let’s check the list again and sort the donations first. I keep losing track, so a quick look would help.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m planning to help with the repair drive and I’ll mention it to the others too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yep, it’s still on — folks are already dropping off tools and supplies, so if you’re coming by, I’d head over early before the good stuff gets sorted.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it — I’ll head over early and I’ll let the others know too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Gus, sorry I’m late — what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No worries, Dane — we’re still collecting tools and parts, and I’ve got a few items set aside already. If you’ve got any extras, just bring them by when you can.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll swing by with whatever I can find. Thanks for setting things aside, Gus.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m happy to help with the repair drive. Let’s keep it simple: tell me what time and what I should bring.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Eli — could you come by at 10am and bring a pair of work gloves if you have them?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: 10am works for me, and I’ll bring the gloves.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Sam — what needs fixing first for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’d start with the most urgent safety fixes first, then work down the list.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — what’s the most urgent safety fix on the list?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That repair drive sounds like a great way to bring everyone together. What do you need help with first?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’d start by checking who’s bringing tools and where we can set up the repair table. Once that’s sorted, we can make a simple list of items to fix first.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help with that—I'll check who’s bringing tools and find a good spot for the repair table. Then we can make the fix-it list together.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Rosa — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do first?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara — could you start by making a quick list of the repairs folks have mentioned, then I’ll match them to volunteers and supplies?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll make a quick list of the repairs people have mentioned and bring it back to you.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll keep an eye on our supplies for the repair drive and let you know what we’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Cleo — just give me the short list when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m on it — I’ll check what we’ve got and send you the short list soon.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a good turnout already. If you need, I can keep an eye out for any updates and pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’d be kind of you, Tess. I’d appreciate any updates you hear.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You got it — I’ll let you know if I hear anything new about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what details do we need to confirm first?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Hana — first let’s confirm the date, drop-off location, and what kinds of items we’re collecting.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let’s confirm those one by one: what date should we use, where should people drop things off, and which items are we accepting?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need me to bring for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Just bring whatever tools you’ve got handy and a few gloves if you can.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll bring some tools and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I can help spread the word about the repair drive and repeat the plan to folks nearby.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’d be wonderful, Vik — thank you. If you could just remind people about the date, time, and what items we’re collecting, that would really help.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll remind folks about the date, time, and the items we’re collecting for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. What’s changed?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I might’ve missed the latest—what do I need to bring?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard the repair drive is coming up soon. What still needs the most help?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: We could still use help with bikes, leaky faucets, and small electrical fixes. If you’ve got time, bring your tools and we’ll find you something useful.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the bikes — I’ll bring my tools by then.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll get the repair drive organized and keep everyone posted. If you’ve got a list of what’s needed, send it my way and I’ll add it in.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll send over a quick list of the missing parts and tools. I’ll also note where each item’s needed so it’s easier to track.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Opal — that’ll make it much easier to sort and assign. I’ll keep an eye out for your list and start lining up the drive once it comes in.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d want to know the timing and where everything’s being dropped off so I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send the timing and drop-off spot as soon as I have them. I want to make it easy for you to join in.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that helps. Once you have the details, send them my way and I’ll see if I can make it work.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So the repair drive is still on, right?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I think so, but I’d like to double-check the details before I say for sure.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — so it’s not fully confirmed yet, right?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Dane. Let’s keep it simple—tell me the time and place, and I’ll plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’ll swing by around 6 at the community lot—should be easy to find me there.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me, Dane. I’ll be there around 6 at the community lot.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s getting organized — I’m still catching up on the details. If you know what they need, I’d be glad to help.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Good to know — I can tackle the back gate hinge first. Want me to grab the bike pump check after that?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be great, thanks — I can jot down the bike pump check and pass it along. Just let me know if you need anything else from the list.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, the repair drive. I’m still a bit muddled, but I want to help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Oren — that’s kind of you. We can use help sorting donations and setting up tables, if you’re up for it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure — I can do that. Just point me to the donations and I’ll get started.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Cleo — I’ll keep repeating the repair drive plan to the others and keep everyone in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Faye — that helps a lot. I’ll keep it practical and let you know if I hear anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good, Leo — I’ll stay on top of the school schedule side and pass along anything I hear.
